parameters.inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"has_quoted_content":{"type":"boolean","description":"true if the email contains a previous forwarded or replied message below the main body"},"quoted_start":{"type":"string","description":"Exact first line where the forwarded or replied content begins, copied verbatim from the input (for example '-----Original Message-----', 'El lun, 3 mar de 2025, Ana escribió:', 'On Mon, Mar 3, 2025, Ana wrote:', 'De: Ana'). Empty string if none."},"has_signature":{"type":"boolean","description":"true if there is a sender signature block or a legal/confidentiality disclaimer"},"signature_start":{"type":"string","description":"Exact first line where the signature block or legal disclaimer begins, copied verbatim from the input. Empty string if none."}},"required":["has_quoted_content","quoted_start","has_signature","signature_start"]}

options.systemPromptTemplate:
You analyse the raw text of one email. Your only task is to locate where the main message written by the sender ends.

Report:
- the exact first line where a quoted, forwarded or replied previous message begins (headers like 'De:', 'From:', '-----Original Message-----', 'El ... escribió:', 'On ... wrote:', or lines starting with '>')
- the exact first line where the sender's signature block or a legal/confidentiality disclaimer begins

Copy those lines character by character from the input. Never paraphrase, translate, trim or summarise them. If something does not exist, return false and an empty string. Do not extract anything else.

parameters.text:
=Translate the following email into English. Preserve line breaks and paragraphs. Output only the translation in this exact layout, with no commentary:

Subject: <translated subject>

<translated body>

If the text is already in English, return it unchanged in that layout.

Subject: {{ $json.subject }}

Body:
{{ $json.clean_body }}
